root_cause.client: The shared SemVer parser first sliced the prerelease token incorrectly and then compared numeric identifiers through Number, losing arbitrary-size precedence. Install switching could leave active=new and backup=old while WAL still said claimed, and exception rollback deleted active before restoring backup, so either crash shape could strand the old receipt and local bytes in a permanent recovery-pending state. Exact version selection also searched only the bounded first detail page, and service/Host failures collapsed to free text.
root_cause.worker: Catalog cursors exposed raw slugs, detail and owned reads used fixed LIMIT 100 queries, model-session sid was validated but discarded, deflate output was fully materialized before its declared expansion size was checked, and tombstone rejection lived only inside same-request replay. The version key length-encoded alphanumeric prerelease identifiers and used a three-digit numeric length, while latest selection had no tie-break for equal precedence. A direct unique index was not deployable over legacy duplicate request rows.
root_cause.resolution: The existing shared lifecycle now stages every switched active tree back to candidate before restoring backup, and restart normalizes claimed, switched and completion-pending disk shapes before reconciliation. SemVer numeric comparison stays decimal-string exact; Worker sort keys use an eight-digit numeric length plus terminated ASCII-hex identifiers and a deterministic version tie-break. Tombstones fail closed before all publish receipt paths. Existing D1 history remains intact while one transactional conditional insert plus its changes receipt serializes request identity. Signed filter-bound keyset cursors, exact reads, Session-mixed credentials, bounded streaming inflate, typed failures and the single native provider/Job/WAL owner remain unchanged.

contract_receipts.single_path: browser or Agent -> /emate.skillHub or typed Tool -> existing component -> managed identity Worker -> existing per-slug WAL -> rc.7 FileSystemSkillProvider -> native Job receipt/inventory
contract_receipts.catalog_detail_version: query/category/tag/source catalog and immutable version history use signed opaque keyset cursors; exact version has a dedicated GET route
contract_receipts.publication: installed native Skills and exact session .e-mate/imports/*.zip identities are accepted; arbitrary host paths, links, hardlinks and changed bytes are rejected
contract_receipts.browser_boundary: browser mutations remain Host RPC calls; Worker rejects Origin/Sec-Fetch bearer transport and emits no CORS grant
contract_receipts.install_credentials: install and completion token digests are mixed with the validated model-session sid ref; another Session cannot consume or complete them; request identity is admitted by one transactional conditional insert without requiring a destructive legacy-row migration
contract_receipts.mutation_identity: publish/delete and install lifecycle receipts show exact slug, version, content digest and publisher; every tombstoned slug/version publish is conflict regardless of client_request_id
contract_receipts.local_lifecycle: install/update/downgrade/enable/disable/uninstall share one slug serializer and WAL; update downgrade is explicit; restart recovery preserves old receipts and candidate bytes across switch and rollback crash shapes before reconciliation
contract_receipts.native_invocation: an installed fixture Skill is loaded by the pinned rc.7 model-facing native skill Tool
contract_receipts.publication_delete_separation: deleting a remote publication leaves the local installed Skill intact; local uninstall is a separate lifecycle mutation
contract_receipts.inventory_refresh: Capability UI rereads receipt/provider inventory after completed, failed or killed native Job terminal state
contract_receipts.download_credential: Host issues at most 32 random five-minute credentials; HEAD does not consume, first verified GET consumes, and digest is rechecked before response
